name: Magnemite (CobbleEffort form)
look: a little silver flying saucer with a domed top, one big glowing green eye, an antenna and a yellow tractor beam
entry: Lights in the night sky over the desert are often swarms of these little saucers. They hum as they drift, and they lift curious objects up in their tractor beams to study them with their one big eye.
how: Wild: uncommon in deserts, badlands and plains, at night.
Evolves into the CobbleEffort Magneton at level 30.
